mu_name_from: Lorencia's object slot 77, from the client's own table in WorldObjectCatalog.cs. MU names the run rather than the member, so there is no friendlier name than the file's.
why_this_one: 45 placements. More of the same wall, without the face.
sheet_scale_from: How many times a sheet crosses the face it is on. MU's UVs put exactly one copy across, which was right for a 128-pixel painting of a whole wall and is wrong for a photograph of two metres of real stone: stretched over a whole wall it reads as a few enormous blotches rather than as masonry.
